text: Two years ago, my twin sister Julia became engaged, and she was going to be married in just two weeks, Helen began. <break time="0.8s" /> Our three bedrooms were side by side on the ground floor, with the doctors room first, Julias in the middle, and mine at the end. <break time="0.8s" /> One night Julia asked me whether I had ever heard a low, clear whistle in the middle of the night, at about three oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> I had not, and we both thought that the sound might come from the gypsies who were camping on the land. <break time="0.8s" /> On that very night, during a wild storm, I heard a terrible scream, and I rushed out into the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> I heard a low whistle and then a loud clanging sound, as if a heavy piece of metal had fallen. <break time="0.8s" /> My sisters door opened, and she came out with her face white with terror, and then she fell to the floor. <break time="0.8s" /> She cried, Oh, my God, Helen, It was the band, The speckled band, and pointed toward the doctors room before she died. <break time="0.8s" /> The police found no marks on her body, and both her door and her window shutters had been locked from the inside. <break time="0.8s" /> Now I am engaged too, and I have had to move into Julias room, where last night I heard that same whistle.
